additional_info.subject: ID0475966-DC/Si-D/CZ- [Y2/SD314047218001] Charger Communication Failure CRM:03276000060
additional_info.body:
Dear Service Coordinator / RC,
I am writing to inform that we are moving the case
0475966
﻿from the Technical Support to the eMobility RC-CZ SI E Queue. We kindly ask you to take over the case and perform the necessary troubleshooting steps.
Customer:
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset:
Y2/SD314047218001
Charger ID / Serial No.:
NpuVpQ
Charger address/functional location:
Priority:
Medium
Handover reason:
Following the first problem you shared.
DC1 Errorcode:4 and DC1_CableTempSensor_XD100 displayed VIV:0 RNE:1 KON:1
This error is also not showing on our side, but in case it appear again, this is the solution.
Measure on-site and confirm the values by measuring directly on the cables coming from the CCS. If you see the same value, then the CCS is faulty and needs replacement. Otherwise, please measure the 1kOhm until you reach the KF212/214.
P1 to P2 and N1 to N2
If you get 1kOhm until the StateMonitor, please try replacing the grey connector with a spare one (they have some connectors on the EcoGs that are not used at all)
Or replace the StateMonitor
I recommend you to take spare CCS and StateMonitor
Regarding the second issue Missing Converters in DC2:
The procedure for the power converter issue, we have analyzed the screenshots provided and confirmed that
PowerConverter[14]
is currently reporting a fault.
To resolve this, please follow the troubleshooting steps below:
1. CanCommLoss:
Inspect the
CanCommLoss
cables attached to Converter
PowerConverter[14]
. Ensure they are securely seated and free of damage.
To confirm that you are checking the converters on the DC2 I’m sharing this screenshot with you since we don’t have the converter serial number.
2. Component Swapping Test:
If the cables are properly connected, please swap Converter [14] with the adjacent functional unit.
▹
If the fault
follows the converter
to the new position, it confirms the hardware itself is faulty.
▹
If the fault
stays at the same position [14]
, the issue likely lies with the cabling or the communication port.
Conclusion:
If the hardware fault is confirmed after the swap, the converter will need to be replaced.
Power Converter AC/DC:
8EM5903-0AA01-0AA2
Kindly pick up the case using "Pick" option in the queue or manually using the "Assign" function from the
eMobility RC-
CZ
SI E Queue
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the case under Documents Tab on ISP.
In case you require Expert Support, kindly create Work-order as per
unified service process
. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
Kindly close the case post resolution following the case handling guidelines.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Technical Support Team –
Felipe Moraes
Please do not change the subject line when replying to this email.

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0475966-DC/Si-D/CZ- [Y2/SD314047218001] Charger Communication Failure CRM:03276000060
additional_info.body:
Dear Felipe,
We diagnosed that issue lies within the converter itself. After replacing it with the functional one the problem moved with the converter.
On February 27, 2026, inverter -TB10 was diagnosed as defective. To verify the fault, a cross-swap was performed with the adjacent unit -TB11; however, the unit remained non-functional. The SCB continues to report "Inverter Fault 14" both before and after the swap.
The wiring has been inspected and is in good condition. The display on this specific unit is completely dark (unresponsive), while all other units are functioning normally.
SN: 2102312VGQLUP9002927 Y R100020G1
Can you please confirm that we can order new one?
8EM5903-0AA01-0AA2
Kind regards,
Milan

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0475966-DC/Si-D/CZ- [Y2/SD314047218001] Charger Communication Failure CRM:03276000060
additional_info.body:
Dear Felipe,
I would like to kindly remind myself and the question regarding the spare part.
Can you please confirm spare part 8EM5903-0AA01-0AA2 to solve our issue with non working converter?
Best regards,
Milan

260413_Jurajda_label.pdf
,
Dear all,
On April 2nd
@Jurajda, Michal (RC-CZ SI EA CS)
replaced the non-functioning converter SN: 2102312VGQLUP9002927 with the new one SN: 2102312VGQLUP8000519.
Just so you know, the converters come without DC and AC plug holders. Holders from the old converter are hard to remove without breaking.
Charger is now without Error flags. The faulty converter has already been sent to the eMobility RMA center.
I will close the ticket.
Kind regards,
Milan
